findings.desc: gate subjectId null-bypass: verifyUsageReceipt checks `subjectId !== undefined` but not `typeof subjectId === \u0027string\u0027`; a runtime-null subjectId (injected via JS cast) satisfies the condition when envelope.storyId is also null (non-story call), producing receiptVerified=true without a genuine string subject binding. Fix: replace the guard with `typeof subjectId === \u0027string\u0027 && subjectId === envelope.storyId`. No test covers this adversarial case.
